counter_evidence.text: flagd itself is evaluating flags without error: paymentFailure impressions report feature_flag_reason=STATIC only in the incident window, and no ERROR reason is present, so the incident is not a flagd evaluation failure or flagd outage.

The 100%-error pattern is not new at 10:15 and not continuous: the PlaceOrder error ratio was 1 at the 09:06 and 09:21 samples, 0 at the 09:36, 09:51 and 10:06 samples, and checkout's Charge client series shows status-2 errors present until about 09:35, absent from about 09:36 to 10:11, then resuming at about 10:12 - the same on/off shape as the paymentFailure variant.

fact.text: Alert condition reproduced at checkout: at 10:16:00 the 5m error rate of oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder server spans was 0.0208/s while the STATUS_CODE_UNSET (success-path) rate was 0, i.e. ~100% of returned PlaceOrder server spans were errors; 30s-resolution counts show all-error from about 10:12-10:13 onward (2 errors / 0 unset per 30s bucket).

Checkout's failing operation is oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with rpc.grpc.status_code=13, and its otel.status_description is 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'.

The only failing downstream call from checkout is oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge: in 10:00:04-10:16:04 checkout recorded 14.23 Charge client calls with rpc_grpc_status_code=0 and 5.84 with rpc_grpc_status_code=2, while CurrencyService/Convert (73.3), CartService/GetCart (21.7), CartService/EmptyCart (14.2), ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (51.6), ShippingService/GetQuote (21.7) and ShipOrder (14.2) were all status 0.

Payment is the deepest failing hop observed: payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries error=true with grpc.error_message and exception 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', stack trace 'at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)'. Over 960s payment recorded 7.47 error and 16 UNSET Charge server spans.

flagd's feature-flag telemetry ties the payment rejections to a specific flag value: for feature_flag_key=paymentFailure, impressions in 10:00:04-10:16:04 were variant 'off' 22.4 and variant '100%' 2.13, while in 09:20-09:36 they were variant '100%' 35.2 and 'off' 2.13.

Variant-level time series for paymentFailure shows 'off' impressions appearing at 10:10:00 (22.0) and 10:11:00 (20.0) and the first '100%' impressions at 10:11:00 (4.0), immediately before Charge/PlaceOrder become all-error; the impression metric is sparse/bursty so it does not resolve the flip instant below about a minute.

For feature_flag_key=paymentFailure, the only reason reported in 10:00:04-10:16:04 is feature_flag_reason=STATIC (increase 24.5); no ERROR resolution reason appears, so flagd evaluated the flag successfully and served a static variant.

No restart or rollout of the involved dependencies is visible: pod flagd-d6485586b-xskfj (image ghcr.io/open-feature/flagd@sha256:634bd059...) and pod payment-6f7bc865d6-s8xt4 (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:33f327b3...) keep the same pod names and image digests from 06:16:04 through 10:16:04.

The operator-noted checkout rollout is visible as a configuration-only change: ReplicaSet checkout-d9bf44475 first appears between the 10:00:04 and 10:10:04 samples, and its pod checkout-d9bf44475-ts8c6 has the same image digest ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635 as the previous pod checkout-677db95fd-g5vc9.

Checkout and payment each had 1 ready replica (kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready=1) continuously from 09:00 to 10:15, so the failures are not a pod-availability or capacity event for either Deployment.

Propagation observed in the sampled traces: frontend span 'POST /api/checkout' has http.status_code=500, frontend 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' has error=true with exception '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: ... Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' have http.status_code=500, and load-generator 'POST' has http.status_code=500.

Checked and found without error spans in the same sampled traces: shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with its POST returning http.status_code=200, currency Currency/Convert otel.status_code=OK with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct rpc.grpc.status_code=0, cart GetCart rpc.grpc.status_code=0, and quote spans carried no error status. This is a sampled view, not a complete call graph.

hypothesis.text: Primary explanation: the fault originates in the feature-flag value served by flagd for key paymentFailure. When the flag resolves to variant '100%' (a 100% fault-injection rate) payment's charge handler throws 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' for every charge, checkout's PlaceOrder consequently returns gRPC 13 for every request, and the CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh alert fires. The same flag is 'off' while charges succeed (09:36-10:11), which explains the all-or-nothing pattern on one unchanged payment pod.

The '100%' variant most likely came from an out-of-band change to flagd's flag definition source (flag configuration served with reason STATIC by the unchanged flagd pod). The exact object holding that configuration and the actor that set it cannot be identified from the available sources.

recommendation.text: Advisory: inspect the flagd flag definition for key paymentFailure and restore its variant from '100%' to 'off' via the normal configuration owner, then confirm Charge successes resume; separately review who/what changed that flag value around 09:05 and 10:11.

report.summary: The alert is firing because checkout's PlaceOrder server spans are ~100% STATUS_CODE_ERROR, and the errors originate in the payment dependency: payment's own grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge spans fail with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' thrown at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37). The trigger is visible in flagd's feature-flag telemetry: the flag key paymentFailure resolved to variant '100%' during the incidents and to 'off' between them, matching the all-fail / all-succeed pattern of the same payment pod. The payment pod and flagd pod were unchanged throughout (payment-6f7bc865d6-s8xt4 and flagd-d6485586b-xskfj, same images since 06:16), and flag evaluations reported reason STATIC with no error reason, so this is a flag configuration value being served at 100% fault rate, not a rollout or evaluation failure of those services. The operator-noted checkout rollout (10:02:43Z, new ReplicaSet checkout-d9bf44475 with an identical image digest) was checked as a candidate cause and rejected: the identical payment error occurred at 09:29 before it, and PlaceOrder succeeded with zero errors for roughly nine minutes after it. Impact observed in the sampled traces extends to frontend, frontend-proxy and load-generator (their own HTTP 500 spans carrying the failed-charge exception); shipping, currency, product-catalog, cart and quote showed no error spans in those traces.
